explore.description: Dispatch Explorer for open-ended discovery and research
explore.template:
DISPATCH TO: explorer
ACTION: Explore
ARTIFACT: exploration KD
SCOPE: {{scope}}
KDS:
  - {{intent_kd}}
RETURN: knowledge/exploration-{{name}}-{{date}}.md
ACCEPTANCE: Exploration KD exists at knowledge/exploration-{{name}}-{{date}}.md with findings in the specified domain

align.description: Dispatch Spec Weaver for specification creation

decompose.description: Dispatch Pathfinder for task decomposition and planning

verify.description: Dispatch Inspector for verification and review

evolve.description: Dispatch Habit Builder for process improvement

commit.description: Dispatch Committer for final commit and push
commit.template:
DISPATCH TO: committer
ACTION: Commit
ARTIFACT: Commit and push changes
MODE: CLEANUP
SCOPE: {{scope}}
KDS:
  - {{intent_kd}}
RETURN: Git push confirmation
ACCEPTANCE: All changes committed and pushed to remote successfully

report.description: Return to Overseer for report generation (no dispatch)

checkpoint.template:
DISPATCH TO: committer
ACTION: Dispatch
ARTIFACT: Checkpoint commit
MODE: CHECKPOINT
SCOPE: {{scope}}
KDS:
  - {{intent_kd}}
RETURN: Git commit confirmation
ACCEPTANCE: Changes committed with semantic message matching the change summary

preflight.template:
DISPATCH TO: committer
ACTION: Dispatch
ARTIFACT: Git workspace state
MODE: PREFLIGHT
SCOPE: {{scope}}
KDS:
  - {{intent_kd}}
RETURN: Git status summary
ACCEPTANCE: Git workspace is clean and feature branch is ready
